purpose: Person-category closure tranche for the final three named political-detention/case subjects, preserving partial locator granularity where the freeze names the person but the retained source is broader than a person-specific case document.
migrationRule: A person counts as migrated only when their entity record points to an existing dedicated person dossier. Person identity never creates culpability, governance, participation, control or Material Participation.
visualRule: Generated visuals stop at the person-identity boundary. A named detention or State-security case identifies the subject of record only and cannot reverse attribution onto that person.
